items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD / arrow-style movement; C = use selected tool; X = check/interact (talk, doors, containers); E = menu (also Escape toggles inventory); F = journal; M = map; toolbar slots clickable with mouse (slot 1 axe x~0.218, 3 can ~0.318, 4 pickaxe ~0.368, 5 scythe ~0.423, 6 fiber ~0.467, y~0.921); number keys did NOT change slots. Mouse click on ground = walk/tool use aimed at cursor; cursor renders as a brown wooden arrow (do not mistake for scenery). Clicking a message box (or its X) dismisses it; Escape did not. Persistent toolbar tooltips (e.g., 'Used to chop wood', 'Fiber — Raw material sourced from plants') can overlay and block inputs — moving cursor away cleared them once and restored an X interaction (Harvey).

TIME/ENERGY: Clock advances in real time (~10 min per ~2 s of action) regardless of blocked movement; frozen clocks are NOT proof of blocked moves. Idle waits do not advance time. Energy drains slowly; a 'Z' bubble appears when tired. At 2:00 am the farmer passes out: black screen, 'Saving'/'Your progress has been saved', then wakes at home 6:00 am next day with reduced energy and lost gold (day 2: 450→? ; day 3→4: 416→405; another pass-out cost 34g earlier).

GREETING QUEST 'Introductions': greet 28 villagers; counts seen: 2/28 start, 3/28 after Jodi, 6/28 after Shane, 7/28 after Harvey, ~8/28 after Alex, ~10/28 after Evelyn+George (George 'Hmmph', Evelyn 'call me Granny'). Greeting = stand adjacent and facing + X; diagonal adjacency fails; advance all dialogue pages and close. Greeted: Jodi (plaza), Penny (near graveyard), Clint (saloon door), Shane (saloon), Harvey (saloon doorway), Alex (near his grandparents' blue house), Evelyn & George (inside blue house). Saloon interior also had Emily (behind bar), Gus (behind bar, unreachable), Vincent (kid, not registered before midnight). NPCs can stand on door tiles and intercept X (Alex blocked the house door).

SALOON: Enter by standing in dark doorway/landing and pressing X (facing up). Inside: Emily/Gus behind bar (unreachable), Vincent/Shane on floor. Exiting the saloon was never solved on day 2; player passed out inside at 2:00 am.

FARM MECHANICS (observed): Basic axe chops weeds/bushes → Fiber (had 8). Axe on stumps: 'Your axe isn't strong enough to break this stump.' Pickaxe swings at rocks did not visibly break them (fresh tool; may need multiple hits/alignment) — uncertain. Rocks, logs, bushes, twigs block movement; clearing only works on the directly faced tile. Movement per 1–2 s hold is small (fraction of a tile), so long treks need repeated holds. Diagonal moves fail if either axis is blocked.

MAP/AREAS: Research Farm west (sandy fields, farmhouse, mailbox w/ envelope icon, chest, minecart track running N-S on east side x~0.9, purple blossom trees); Pelican Town east across river; Cindersap Forest south-west (pond, Wizard's Tower-like dark building, graveyard); Bus Stop at town's north-west; Stardrop Saloon near plaza; blue house with green door = Alex's grandparents' (Evelyn/George), opens 8:00 am–8:00 pm, 'It's locked' before 8. Clinic (Harvey, green cross) NE of plaza; red-ring plaza center town.

NAVIGATION LEARNED: Farmhouse exit = bottom-center notch; porch descent only over the front-center stair planks (x~0.4–0.6), elsewhere blocked. Town route day 2/3 worked: yard east of farmhouse → sand path east past mailbox → gap by signpost → wide dirt-road corridor between fences → paved road east past bus stop → town plaza → saloon. North pasture gate near farmhouse (offset fence rows, paving crossing x~0.5) repeatedly failed to pass north (many alignment attempts); this gate was NOT actually used for the successful route. Bus is out of service ('The bus to Calico Desert is out of service').

TOWN HOUSE INTERIORS: Blue house (green door) entered by standing on doormat under the green door facing up and pressing X. Interior: main hall with gold rug, red carpet leading north to top-center dark double door, hall doorway pillars, kitchen (Evelyn), dining table/chairs west, purple TV room east (George in wheelchair under TV, TV, bench). Exiting was extremely hard: bottom-wall notched black gaps at various columns (x~0.2, 0.33, 0.42–0.49, 0.57, 0.63, 0.67) mostly failed; eventually the bottom-notch tile walk worked (screen warped outside at 7:10 pm) — exact trigger tile not precisely identified; stand on the notch tile and hold S. Upstairs hall reached via top-left dark opening; Alex's bedroom door: 'You're not good enough friends with Alex to enter his bedroom.' X at top double door once gave Alex's dialogue ('I'll see you around.').

SALOON (day 3): entered via X on top landing facing up (~9:30–10 pm). Shane greeted, Vincent unresolved (many failed X attempts, misidentification of player vs NPC sprites; player = brown/dark hair + red top/jacket in some frames, purple hair + blue jacket in others — sprite appearance reading was UNRELIABLE). Passed out in saloon 2:00 am day 2→3.

DAY 4 (Thu 4): woke 6:00 am, 405g; farmhouse exit, town route reused, arrived plaza 7:10 am; blue house locked till 8; greeted Alex (~8:20), entered blue house ~9:30, greeted Evelyn & George (~10:30); stuck until ~7:10 pm; exited blue house; 7:10–7:30 pm walked west via plaza/garden/planters; now 7:30 pm on dirt path west of town garden, heading west toward bus stop corridor and farmhouse to sleep before 2:00 am.

FAILED/RISKY PATTERNS: (1) Wandering far east farm field / Cindersap Forest at night — led to pass-outs; (2) Trying to leave blue house via bottom notches repeatedly while misaligned; (3) Combined key actions like W+X, D+4, D+C may swing/act before facing — prefer separate facing tap then action; (4) Assuming clock freeze = block (wrong); (5) Clicking things under tooltips (input swallowed); (6) Believing the mouse cursor arrow was an in-world exit marker (wrong).

ACTIVE GOAL: get home to farmhouse bed before 2:00 am (or accept ~34g pass-out save); continue Introductions (10/28) tomorrow by greeting remaining villagers (Vincent, Emily, Gus, Robin/Maru/Demetrius up mountain road, Pierre, Marnie, etc.). Open questions: exact tile/technique that exited the blu
